from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689749/attempts/31c36fde4a524b3f9529214b2feb9fae/system/state/workspace/programs/task-e6301578.py')
p.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=max(set(x for r in grid for x in r), key=lambda c:sum(v==c for r in grid for v in r))
    colors=set(x for r in grid for x in r)-{bg}
    for c in colors:
        pts=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j]==c]
        # infer a line direction from any collinear pair; extend it in both directions
        found=None
        for a in range(len(pts)):
            for b in range(a+1,len(pts)):
                dr=pts[b][0]-pts[a][0]; dc=pts[b][1]-pts[a][1]
                import math
                g=math.gcd(abs(dr),abs(dc)); sr,sc=dr//g,dc//g
                if all((r-pts[a][0])*sc==(j-pts[a][1])*sr for r,j in pts):
                    found=(pts[a],sr,sc); break
            if found: break
        if found:
            (r,j),sr,sc=found
            while 0<=r-sr<h and 0<=j-sc<w: r-=sr; j-=sc
            while 0<=r<h and 0<=j<w:
                if out[r][j]==bg: out[r][j]=c
                r+=sr; j+=sc
    return out
''')
print(p)
